summary: Iteration 21 - Complete testing of supplier price confirmation feature. All 12 backend tests passed. All 11 frontend features verified via Playwright. Features tested: confirm-price endpoint, dispute flow, finances endpoint with confirmed/pending breakdown, UI badges for confirmed/disputed/pending states.
seed_data_creation: Used existing test demands: a2d8e3b0-388d-4cd0-ac76-b4a8cd2a4d55 (confirmed), a26298e5-222b-4bab-b63c-4eddcb74150f (disputed during test)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Price confirmation feature fully tested. Key test demands: a2d8e3b0 (price confirmed), a26298e5 (price disputed with reason). Supplier finances endpoint returns total_income (confirmed only), total_pending, confirmed_jobs, pending_jobs. Sidebar finance widget shows both confirmed and pending amounts.

BACKEND_CONFIRM_PRICE_TRUE.details: POST /api/demands/{id}/confirm-price with confirmed=true marks demand price as confirmed

BACKEND_CONFIRM_PRICE_FALSE.details: POST /api/demands/{id}/confirm-price with confirmed=false and reason marks as disputed

BACKEND_CONFIRM_PRICE_403.details: Returns 403 if not the assigned supplier (customer blocked)

BACKEND_CONFIRM_PRICE_400.details: Returns 400 if already confirmed/disputed (double confirmation blocked)

BACKEND_SUPPLIER_FINANCES.details: GET /api/suppliers/{id}/finances returns total_income, total_pending, confirmed_jobs, pending_jobs

FRONTEND_PRICE_CONFIRMATION_SECTION.details: DemandDetail shows 'POTVRZENÍ CENY' section for supplier on completed demand with unconfirmed price

FRONTEND_CONFIRM_BUTTON.details: Supplier can click 'Souhlasím s cenou' button to confirm

FRONTEND_DISPUTE_FORM.details: Supplier can click 'Nesouhlasím' to show dispute form with textarea

FRONTEND_CONFIRMED_BADGE.details: After confirmation, green badge 'Dodavatel potvrdil cenu' appears with date

FRONTEND_PENDING_BADGE.details: Customer sees 'Čeká na potvrzení ceny dodavatelem' badge on unconfirmed demand (verified via code review - badge shows when price_confirmed_by_supplier === null)

FRONTEND_SIDEBAR_FINANCE.details: Supplier dashboard sidebar shows 'Potvrzené příjmy' (32,500 Kč, 2 jobs) + 'Čeká na potvrzení' (15,000 Kč, 1 job) separately
